question.text: What is the minimum investment amount required to open a Portfolio Management Services (PMS) account in India?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the product-comparison table in NISM Series X-B, the minimum investment size for PMS is Rs. 50 lakhs, AIF is Rs. 1 crore, and an equity mutual fund subscription can be as low as Rs. 1,000. PMS investments are held in the individual investor's demat account, distinguishing PMS from pooled vehicles. The Trap: Rs. 1 crore is the minimum for AIF, not PMS, so candidates who mix up these HNI products will pick the wrong figure. Lower amounts (Rs. 10 lakhs, Rs. 25 lakhs) are not the current PMS threshold from the source table. Note: When comparing minimum investment sizes across PMS, AIF, and mutual funds, rely on the current X-B comparison table figures rather than historical or memorised older thresholds.
